system.biography:
Combat

Leonals like their battles as straightforward as can be. They begin with a roar to put their foes off balance, then follow up with a frenzy of claw and bite attacks. They closely coordinate with others in their pride, watching one another’s flanks and setting up devastating attacks.

A leonal’s natural weapons, as well as any weapons it wields, are treated as good-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Roar (Su)

A leonal can roar up to three times per day. Each roar releases a blast in a 60-foot cone that duplicates the effects of a holy word spell and deals an extra 2d6 points of sonic damage (Fortitude DC 20 negates). The save DC is Charisma-based.

Pounce (Ex)

If a leonal charges a foe, it can make a full attack, including two rake attacks.

Improved Grab (Ex)

To use this ability, a leonal must hit with its bite attack. It can then attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity. If it wins the grapple check, it establishes a hold and can rake.

Rake (Ex)

Attack bonus +20 melee, damage 1d6+8.

Spell-Like Abilities

At will—detect thoughts, fireball (DC 15), hold monster (DC 17), wall of force; 3/day—cure critical wounds (DC 16), neutralize poison, remove disease; 1/day—heal (DC 18). Caster level 10th. The save DCs are Charisma-based.

Lay on Hands (Su)

As the paladin class feature, except that each day, a leonal can heal an amount of damage equal to its full normal hit points.

Protective Aura (Su)

Against attacks made or effects created by evil creatures, this ability provides a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws to anyone within 20 feet of the leonal. Otherwise, it functions as a magic circle against evil effect and a lesser globe of invulnerability, both with a radius of 20 feet (caster level equals leonal’s HD). (The defensive benefits from the circle are not included in a leonal’s statistics block.)

Speak with Animals (Su)

This ability works like speak with animals (caster level 8th) but is a free action and does not require sound.

Skills

Leonals have a +4 racial bonus on Balance, Hide, and Move Silently checks.

system.description: You are adept at dodging blows.
system.benefit: During your action, you designate an opponent and receive a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks from that opponent. You can select a new opponent on any action.

system.description: You are skilled at dodging past opponents and avoiding their attacks.
system.benefit: You get a +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks of opportunity caused when you move out of or within a threatened area. A condition that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most types of bonuses.
system.special: A fighter may select Mobility as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You can move, attack, and move again before your foes can react.
system.prerequisites: Dex 13, Dodge, Mobility, base attack bonus +4
system.benefit: As a full-round action, you can move up to your speed and make a single melee attack at any point during your movement. You must move at least 10 feet before and after your attack. You may not take a 5-foot step before, during, or after this action.
system.special: A fighter may select Spring Attack as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You can follow the trails of creatures and characters across most types of terrain.
system.benefit: To find tracks or to follow them for 1 hour requires a Survival check. You must make another Survival check every hour to continue following the tracks. The DC depends on the surface and the prevailing conditions.
system.special: A ranger automatically gains Track as a bonus feat at 1st level. He need not select it.

system.description: Check: You can walk on a precarious surface. A successful check lets you move at half your speed along the surface for 1 round. A failure by 4 or less means you can't move for 1 round. A failure by 5 or more means you fall.
Make a Concentration check whenever you might be distracted (by taking damage, by harsh weather, and so on) while engaged in some action that requires your full attention.
You can use this skill to persuade others to agree with your arguments, to resolve differences, and to gather valuable information or rumors from people.
Make a Hide check to conceal yourself from enemies, slink past guards, slip away without being noticed, or sneak up on people without being seen or heard.
You can use this skill to frighten opponents or to get them to act in a way that benefits you.
You can make running or standing jumps.
Ancient mysteries, magic traditions, arcane symbols, cryptic phrases, constructs, dragons, magical beasts. Like other Knowledge skills, each Knowledge field is a separate skill with its own ranks.
Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
Make a Move Silently check when you try to sneak past enemies or move without being heard.
You can get a hunch about a social situation or read a person.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.
You are skilled at surviving in the wild and at following tracks.

ThirdEra: Add rake attacks to the NPC’s Natural attacks list on the sheet (or note them in Description) so attack bonuses match the stat block. This template keeps Mechanical effects and Capability grants empty.
SRD: Immune to electricity.
Lay on Hands (Su): Heals damage per Hit Dice as the paladin class feature; can harm undead with a touch.

Protective Aura (Su): Against attacks made or effects created by evil creatures, this ability provides a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws to anyone within 20 feet of the angel. Otherwise, it functions as magic circle against evil and lesser globe of invulnerability, both with a radius of 20 feet (caster level equals the angel’s HD). The aura can be dispelled; the angel can recreate it as a free action on its next turn. Defensive benefits from the circle are not included in the printed statistics block.
Speak with Animals (Su): The creature can use speak with animals at will.

Roar (Su): Up to three times per day — 60-ft. cone duplicates holy word and deals an extra 2d6 sonic damage (Fort DC 20 negates sonic portion per SRD); Charisma-based.

Spell-like abilities: At will — detect thoughts, fireball (DC 15), hold monster (DC 17), wall of force; 3/day — cure critical wounds (DC 16), neutralize poison, remove disease; 1/day — heal (DC 18). Caster level 10th; save DCs Charisma-based.

Defenses: Damage reduction 10/evil and silver; spell resistance 28; immunity to petrification; resistance to sonic 10 (cold resistance is on a separate embedded item).

Good weapons (Ex): Natural and wielded weapons count as good for overcoming DR.

Speak with animals (Su): As the spell (CL 8th) as a free action without sound — see also the separate template item if present.
